reason: My caffeine is already sorted: coffee in the morning, matcha sometimes, water on the bike or trail. I don't see why I'd pay 55 CZK for a can of something I suspect tastes like fizzy grass tea.
objection: Unsweetened yerba mate sounds bitter, and with no sugar I worry the lemon and grapefruit won't hide it. At 55 CZK I'm not paying to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A free sample at a cafe or at the finish of a race or group ride, so I could taste it before buying.
